shared_values: A Formula 1 team relies on precise measurement and clear information shared fast between the factory and the track. Canon makes the printers, cameras, medical scanners and chipmaking equipment that businesses rely on for the same precision.
flags: Capacity: strong. FY2025 net sales JPY 4,624.7bn (Printing 53.9%, Imaging 22.8%, Medical 12.6%, Industrial 7.8%); FY2026 projection JPY 4,766.0bn; Q3 2026 results 27 Oct 2026; Jan 2026 tender offer for Canon Electronics shares and Oct 2026 merger agreement with Canon Electron Tubes & Devices.
Not a current F1 partner. Heritage: Canon sponsored Williams 1985-1993 (four constructors' titles) and Brawn GP at Singapore 2009 (Wikipedia). Useful in a call; kept out of the email.
Grid note: HP holds PCs and printers as Ferrari's title partner and Xerox is at Aston Martin, so both teams are likely closed for printing.
Sector left out: commercial printers (production printing) and display makers (Canon Tokki) not cited; no honest grid example found.
Same industry in batch: Ricoh, Brother and Nikon are also in this batch; separate companies, not the same house. Pitch Canon and Nikon on different categories.
Regional split FY2025: Americas 32%, Europe 26%, Japan 21%, Asia and Oceania 21% (global.canon).
